traits.silhouette: A low, long, stocky four-legged beast with a heavy chest, a thick tail that sweeps up at the tip, and a row of tall curved spikes running from the neck down the back and tail.
traits.head: A big, wide, toad-like head with two long curved horns, small pointed ears, glowing red-orange eyes, and a huge grinning mouth showing a row of teeth and two long tusks that point down.
traits.limbs: Short, thick, bent legs with big paws, each toe ending in a long curved white claw.
traits.hide: Dark, shaggy, rough fur or scaly hide, with white-bone horns, spines, tusks and claws standing out against it.
traits.colours: Near-black green body with teal and green highlights, bone-white horns, spikes, claws and tusks, and red-orange eyes.
child: A black, wide-grinning monster with two big horns and big white fangs.
A row of white spikes down its back and tail.
